name: list_disputes
description: List facts currently in a disputed resolution (comparable-authority conflicts) for the caller's tenant: subject, predicate, current value, policy_version, reason. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

limit.description: Max disputes to return, intended range 1..100 (default 100). Upper bound still capped server-side; DEGRADATION: the Gateway no longer enforces the lower bound >=1.
